meta.title: Interim CTO · Technology Turnaround — Jacek Janczura
meta.description: Interim CTO and AI lead for companies mid-turnaround: off the monolith, the compliance gaps auditors flag closed, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 in about three months — without freezing the roadmap. Then a clean handover to a team that runs it.

hero.title: Modernise the stack — and pass the audit — without freezing the roadmap.
hero.sub: I step into companies mid-turnaround and take legacy debt off the critical path: off the monolith, the compliance gaps auditors flag closed, and AI added only where it moves a number. I took my own company from pentest findings to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certification in about three months, without pausing delivery. Then I hand you a team that runs it without me.
hero.availability: Fractional CTO & consulting partner · open to the right permanent CTO or Head of AI role

plan.title: A plan that assembles itself.
plan.lede: Not a discovery phase that never ends. A dated path from "we're not sure what's on fire" to "the team owns it" — the same path I ran at my own company, from pentest findings to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, in about three months.

milestones.title: Risk & architecture read
milestones.body: I map the monolith, the dependency graph and the gaps auditors will flag. You get the real picture — not the org chart.

milestones.title: Standards & CI/CD quality gates live
milestones.body: Automated quality gates, security baselines and a working path off the critical dependencies. The team keeps shipping.

milestones.title: Measurable wins + a board-ready roadmap
milestones.body: Legacy debt moves off the critical path, one metric moves, and the board gets a roadmap they can fund.

milestones.title: A team that runs it without me
milestones.body: Ownership stays inside the company. A clear end, not an open-ended arrangement.

plan.work: How I work: in your Slack and your code review, making the calls — then a clean handover. A clear end, not an open-ended arrangement.

proof.title: Three turnarounds I have actually run

items.title: An entangled monolith became micro-frontends
items.body: I led the architectural redesign of a large, entangled frontend monolith into micro-frontends, so teams got deployment independence and the codebase stopped being one shared blast radius.
items.label: How the team and platform were built

items.title: Pentest findings to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 in about three months
items.body: Certification ran as an engineering programme: controls, evidence collection and process changes alongside delivery, so the roadmap never stopped for the auditors.
items.label: The decisions behind it

items.title: Platform reliability for 50+ organisations
items.body: Event-driven services on AWS with serverless autoscaling and cost tuning: more than 1,000 concurrent connections and thousands of requests a second at 99.9% uptime, on one multi-tenant platform.
items.label: The outcome in full
